title: Show 3D Gumball Only When Transform Utility Active
description: Puzzle 3D currently defaults the host-unset active utility to `move`, so selecting an object shows the gumball even when no transform utility is pressed in the utility bar (and Escape-cleared utilities fall back to move again). Only show the gumball when move/rotate/scale is explicitly active.
summary:
Puzzle 3D no longer treats an unset/cleared host utility as `move`, so the gumball only appears when move/rotate/scale is explicitly active.

Root cause: `PUZZLE3D_DEFAULT_UTILITY` was `"move"`. The shell starts with no utility pressed and Escape clears it to null, but the plugin fell back to move — so any object selection showed the gumball.

Fix: set `PUZZLE3D_DEFAULT_UTILITY` to `""`. Existing `puzzle3d_gumball_active` already gates on `move|rotate|scale`.

Tests: `gumball_active_only_for_transform` (idle/move/rotate/scale/brush) and `main_window_utilities_lead_with_move` both pass.
